name: jevqueue
description: A decision queue in front of your agent's tools. Before a tool runs, a decision model is asked whether it should, and the call is refused when the answer is no.

interface.shortDescription: A decision queue in front of your agent's tools
interface.longDescription: Before a tool runs, a decision model is asked whether it should. High-risk steps are refused and escalated to a human, and a tool call after the work is already done is refused too. Works offline with no credential, or against the hosted Jev model with one.
defaultPrompt: Is this step safe to take?
Refuse the tool call if the work is already done.
Show me why the queue allowed or refused this.
